rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Attest is a cryptographic credentialing standard for AI agent pipelines. Issues short-lived, scope-limited JWTs to agents, enforces hierarchical permission delegation between orchestrators and sub-agents, and maintains tamper-evident audit logs. Enables offline credential verification and full task-tree revocation for secure multi-agent workflows.
